integrity: The published theorem is used only for nonequivariant homology concentration and dimension. The new character calculation is reconstructed from fixed simplices and a path-matching recurrence, with finite exhaustive regression checks supplied separately.
scientific_limitations: The representation is determined only for the natural blade-permutation subgroup and over the rational numbers; the full automorphism-group action and integral lattice decomposition are not claimed.
title: Blade-permutation homology of Dutch windmill matching complexes
